definition: Area (mm²) and area centroid of the whole, blade and handle contours. Outer contours only: holes such as the Round Hole are not subtracted.

Major second-moment axis of the blade and handle regions, through their area centroids. Angle in degrees from +x of the handle frame, positive towards −y (counter-clockwise on screen). The blade axis points towards the tip, the handle axis towards the butt.

layers.principal_axes: principal axes of blade and handle

definition: Bounding boxes of whole, blade and handle: axis-aligned in the handle frame, and oriented along each part's own principal axis.
Segment from the midpoint of the blade/handle junction to the tip. The pivot is not detected in S1: this is not a pivot→tip axis.

Segment from the pivot centre to the tip: length, angle, and signed deviation from the extension of the handle axis towards the blade (positive towards −y, up on screen). Absent when no pivot was found.
Segment from the butt (handle contour point farthest from the junction midpoint) to the pivot centre: length, angle, signed deviation from the handle axis extension. Absent when no pivot was found.
Segment from the butt to the blade/handle junction midpoint: length, angle, signed deviation from the handle axis extension.

Signed deviation (degrees) of the blade principal axis and of the junction→tip axis from the extension of the handle axis beyond the junction. Positive towards −y (up on screen, the spine side on Spyderco show-side photos).

Extents of the whole knife along (x) and across (y) the handle axis; tip offset from the handle axis (positive towards −y); junction→tip length; handle length from the butt extreme to the junction midpoint along x; widths of blade and handle across their own principal axes.
